title: The crab that grips like a lion's bite 🦀 #shorts
description: The coconut crab is the largest land arthropod, and it can climb trees and kill birds. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know the biggest land invertebrate can crush with the force of a lion's jaw? The coconut crab spans over three feet across the legs and weighs up to nine pounds. Measurements of its claw put the pinching force in the thousands of newtons, comparable to the bite of a large predator. It climbs trees, cracks open coconuts, and has been filmed killing and eating a seabird. Strangest of all, it breathes air and drowns if held underwater, despite being a crab.

title: The snake that made a scientist write his own autopsy ✍️ #shorts
description: The boomslang's venom stops blood clotting, and one bite produced a famous death diary. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know a scientist once documented his own death from a snakebite, hour by hour? In nineteen fifty-seven the herpetologist Karl Schmidt was bitten by a young boomslang and believed the dose was too small to matter. Boomslang venom prevents blood from clotting, and it works slowly, so he went home and kept notes. Over the next day he recorded his nausea, his fever, and the bleeding from his gums and eyes. He died the following afternoon. His diary is still cited in medical literature.

title: The snake that destroys a gland you need to live 🐍 #shorts
description: Survivors of Russell's viper bites can lose the function of their pituitary gland forever. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a snake whose survivors are never the same again? Russell's viper is among the biggest killers of people in South Asia, hiding in farmland where crops are harvested by hand. Its venom shreds blood vessels and stops clotting, but there's a stranger effect. The bleeding can destroy the pituitary gland at the base of the brain. Patients who survive the bite may lose the hormones that control growth, energy and fertility, sometimes years later, from a bite everyone thought they'd walked away from.

title: The snake that tricks fish into its mouth 🎣 #shorts
description: The tentacled snake fakes an attack so the fish escapes straight into its jaws. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a snake that uses a fish's own reflexes against it? The tentacled snake hangs in the water in a J shape, with two small feelers on its snout that detect water movement. When a fish comes near, the snake twitches the side of its body, not its head. The fish's escape reflex fires automatically, flinging it away from the sound, and straight toward the waiting jaws. The snake strikes at where the fish is going to be. It's one of the fastest strikes ever filmed.

script: Did you know there's a fish you can see straight into? The barreleye has a dome of transparent tissue over the top of its skull, filled with clear fluid, and floating inside it are two enormous green eyes. title: The fish that plays dead to hunt 💀 #shorts
description: This cichlid lies on the lake floor pretending to be a rotting corpse. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fish that fakes its own death to catch a meal? In Lake Malawi, the sleeper cichlid drops onto its side on the sandy bottom and lies completely still. Its blotchy brown and white pattern looks like the discoloured skin of a fish that's been dead for days. Scavengers and small fish come in to pick at the body. The moment they're close enough, the corpse explodes upward and swallows them. Fishermen on the lake named it after a creature that ambushes sleepers.

script: Did you know there's an animal called a sea angel that hunts with hooks hidden in its head? Clione limacina is a translucent sea slug that swims by flapping two wing-like flaps, drifting through cold seas. It eats only one thing, a snail called the sea butterfly. When it finds one, its head splits open and six grasping cones shoot out, gripping the shell. Rows of tiny hooks then drag the soft body out through the opening, and the angel feeds slowly, for hours.

title: The fish with human teeth 🦷 #shorts
description: The pacu has flat square molars that look unsettlingly like a person's. #shorts #animals #nature #facts #didyouknow #wildlife
script: Did you know there's a fish with a mouth full of human-looking teeth? The pacu is a close relative of the piranha, but instead of blades it grew flat square molars, in rows, that look uncannily like a person's. It uses them to crush nuts and seeds that fall into the rivers of the Amazon, and it can grow past three feet long and eighty pounds. The tabloid stories about pacu attacking swimmers are almost entirely myth. The teeth, however, are completely real.
